prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1408; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this office has been retained to represent our client in connection with injuries sustained in a low-speed head-on collision involving your insured. Our client was seriously hurt in the incident and is currently receiving medical treatment for those injuries. Accordingly, please direct all further communication regarding this matter, including any contact with our client, to this office rather than to our client directly.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm the name of the adjuster assigned to this claim.

Finally, we ask that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes vehicle data and event recorder information, photographs, witness statements, claim file materials, repair estimates, and any telematics or dash camera footage. Please treat this letter as formal notice of our client's claim and of the need to preserve all such materials.
